A young bird takes its first flight.

A young black stork in Gansu, China, has finally left its nest. The bird had a broken leg, so it stayed behind after the other young birds flew away. Its nest was on a cliff near the wetlands in Zhangye.

A filmmaker called Zhao Hai watched the bird through a camera near the nest. At first, the young bird seemed unsure about leaving. When it flew, its parents stayed close and flew beside it for a while. Zhao has watched birds for about thirty years.

Black storks do not like people coming too close. Zhao tries to film them without disturbing them. His pictures show small moments in their lives, including how the parents care for their young. The story gives readers a close look at a bird family.
